pages.name: Pirc Defense: Kholmov System
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the queen Qe1-h4 before f2-f4 had cleared f2. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc: 3.f3 e5 Queenswap
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black castle long after the forced ...Kxd8; both plans wrote castling as 0-0-0. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc: 3.Nc3 e5 Queenswap
pages.notes: Plan 1 named Black's ...Kxd8 as a White move. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc/Reti: Wade Defence
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4 onto the bishop's square; plan 4 assumed ...Bxf3 damages White's structure whatever the recapture. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc Defense: Classical Variation, Quiet System, Parma Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured gxf3 to open the g-file with the e2-bishop able to take; plan 2 claimed ...Bxf3 leaves a structural weakness. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc: Classical, 5.Bc4 c6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 with the knight on f3 and said a3 prevents ...b5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc: Classical, 5.Be2 c6
pages.notes: Plan 2 named ...b4 as a single move and said a3 prevents it; plan 1 said ...b5 challenges e4. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc: Classical, 5.Be2 O-O 6.O-O Bg4 7.Be3 Nc6 8.Qd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4 onto the bishop's square; plan 3 played ...c7-c5 with the knight on c6. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (reviewer: plan 3 rejected once for a g7-bishop blocked by f6 and a pin with only the e2-bishop behind, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc Defense: Austrian Attack, Dragon Formation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g5 with the g-pawn on g2 and gave queenside castling as the main idea. Rewrote plans 1 and 2 around 6.dxc5 and 6.Bb5+; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc Defense: Austrian Attack, Ljubojevic Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the queen Qe1-h4; plan 3 routed a knight via c7, where the c-pawn stands. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (reviewer: plan 3 rejected once as unconfirmed, revised to ...O-O and ...c6, re-accepted); British spelling.
